en.completion.description: Played when a session goes from running to idle
en.completion.title: Task finished
en.custom.description: Upload an audio file (up to 512KB) to pick it as the "Custom" option above
en.custom.title: Custom sound
en.custom.tooLarge: File exceeds 512KB; please compress it and retry
en.custom.undecodable: Could not decode this audio: the file may be damaged, or this environment cannot decode audio
en.decision.description: Played when the agent raises an approval or plan review
en.decision.title: Approval needed
en.enabled.description: Turn off to stop every alert: sounds, system notifications, and repeat reminders
en.enabled.title: Enable alerts
en.goalFinalOnly.description: A goal runs several automatic rounds; with this on, intermediate rounds stay silent and one chime marks the end of the goal (or a pause or block). Ordinary sessions are unaffected
en.goalFinalOnly.title: Only alert on the final goal round
en.intro: Get your attention when the agent needs a decision (approvals, questions) or finishes a task: sounds, optional system notifications, and repeat reminders.
en.notify.completion.body: The agent has finished the current task
en.notify.completion.title: Task finished
en.notify.decision.body: The agent is waiting for your decision
en.notify.decision.title: Your decision is needed
en.onlyWhenHidden.description: Play only while another window or tab is focused, so an active page stays quiet
en.onlyWhenHidden.title: Only when the page is hidden
en.question.description: Played when the agent asks you a question
en.question.title: Question asked
en.quiet.description: No alerts during this daily time range (may wrap past midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 08:00)
en.quiet.title: Quiet hours
en.renotify.browserHint: Background browser tabs throttle timers, so the interval can stretch (most visible at the 1-minute setting)
en.renotify.description: Re-ping decisions that stay unanswered at a fixed interval; once you have seen one — it appeared while you were at the window, or you came back to it — it never repeats, even if you leave again
en.renotify.title: Repeat unanswered decisions
en.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
en.subagent.description: Also alert when a sub-agent finishes or needs a decision; off means only your own conversations
en.subagent.title: Sub-agent alerts
en.systemNotify.denied: Denied — allow notifications in the browser or system settings and retry
en.systemNotify.description: Show an OS notification while the page is hidden; click it to focus the window
en.systemNotify.title: System notifications
en.systemNotify.unsupported: System notifications are unavailable in this environment
en.title: Notification sounds
en.titleFlash.description: While the page is hidden, mark the window title as waiting for you or finished, so the taskbar shows it; cleared when you return
en.titleFlash.macUnsupported: Not supported on macOS, so this switch is disabled: the title bar is hidden and the Dock shows no window title, so the mark has nowhere to appear (only the Window menu and Mission Control would show it)
en.titleFlash.title: Window title alert
en.update.applyFailed: Update failed ({stage}) — the previous version is intact
en.update.auto.description: At most one quiet check a day; a newer version is only marked below, never announced
en.update.description: Check npm for a newer version of this plugin and install it in one click
en.update.desktopGuidance: Update through the package manager: Settings → Plugins → remove this plugin, then add dsh-plugin-notify-sounds again. The installer keeps the upgrade (this plugin no longer replaces its own files)
en.update.doneDetail: Updated: {from} → {to} — restart DSH to load it
en.update.reinstall: Remove this plugin under Settings → Plugins, then add dsh-plugin-notify-sounds again. Repository: {url}
en.update.retry: This is usually a temporary network or proxy problem — try again later. If it keeps failing, install manually from {url}
en.update.title: Updates
en.update.unregistered: This install is not registered with the package manager (it still records {recorded}), so a later plugin install may roll it back. Reinstall it with the step above.
en.update.webGuidance: Run dsh plugin --profile {profile} add dsh-plugin-notify-sounds@{version} in a terminal
en.volume.description: Playback loudness of the notification sounds
en.volume.title: Volume
